description: This file contains the implementation of the Sizzle CSS Selector Engine v1.10.17-pre, a JavaScript library for CSS selector parsing and DOM element matching.

methods.name: Sizzle
methods.description: Main function for selecting DOM elements based on CSS selectors.

methods.name: Sizzle.matches
methods.description: Returns elements matching a given selector from a set of elements.

methods.name: Sizzle.matchesSelector
methods.description: Checks if a single element matches a given selector.

methods.name: Sizzle.contains
methods.description: Checks if a DOM element contains another.

methods.name: Sizzle.attr
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an attribute from a DOM element.

methods.name: Sizzle.uniqueSort
methods.description: Sorts an array of DOM elements and removes duplicates.

methods.name: Sizzle.setDocument
methods.description: Initializes document-related variables for the current document context.

methods.name: Sizzle.compile
methods.description: Compiles a CSS selector into a function for matching elements.

methods.name: Sizzle.select
methods.description: Executes a compiled selector function to find matching elements.
